## Disclosure

Investment dealer dealing representatives ("Investment Advisor") registered with Manulife Wealth Inc. offer stocks, bonds and mutual funds. Insurance products and services are offered through Manulife Wealth Insurance Services Inc. Please confirm with your Advisor which company you are dealing with for each of your products and services.
